=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:45-54 (counterpart: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py vs workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The PR changes the template hook workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, adding --tests-file and --expect-baseline-fail-file, but leaves the live copy .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py unchanged, so the byte-and-mode parity check fails ("AssertionError: Live .claude/ copies differ from workflow-templates/.claude/ for: hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py").
  WHY: The required job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator is red on head 6573bd5d17f2273b42c814814b33117eff90b619 (run 41432976281; minimax also cites 41432984880) because push events run strict parity with CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA empty, so main will also be red after merge. The fix is for a trusted writer to copy the template over the live file (mode 0755) or run scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py sync. Adding the file to the divergence allowlist is not a valid fix, because mismatched() would then skip the pair. Severity disagreement: sonnet BLOCKER, minimax MAJOR, gemini gave none; the highest (BLOCKER→critical) is used. minimax notes that the pipeline gate paths stage the template copy, so only this repo's interactive pre-push hook runs the stale copy, and that PR-event CI is green by design (G6).
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:573-588 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `_candidates` de-duplication (`if number is None or number in seen: continue`) keeps the first occurrence of an issue listed twice. The listing is read `sort=updated&direction=asc` (line 806), so an issue updated between page reads keeps its stale, older `updated_at` snapshot.
  WHY: Two code paths read the stale `updated_at`. With the switch off, cleanup_disabled (lines 597-600) can remove ai:verify-pending before the window has really passed. With the switch on, check_one's marker_settling guard (line 645) can treat a just-armed issue as settled. Fix: key by number (`by_number[number] = item`) so the newer occurrence wins, then sort by _updated_key. All four reviewers rated it NIT (→low); confidence ranged 3-4.
- agents.d/8427-p5-persist-postmerge-verify.md:10 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "API budget" bullet still says "at most 1 + 9 x MAX_PER_TICK per tick". The scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py docstring (lines 53-55) and the page loop (805-817) now allow up to 5 list reads, so the real ceiling is 5 + 9 x MAX_PER_TICK.
  WHY: There is no runtime failure, but the contractual operations fragment understates the per-tick API budget, which can mislead budget validation or operator audits. Both reviewers rated it NIT (→low), with confidence 4 and 3. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan P3 routes done-check tests through "scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh --tests-file / --expect-baseline-fail-file", backed by "workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (P3, additive; ships to consumers per §14)"; this repo's live .claude/ hook must support those options and stay byte-identical to the template.
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (must be byte-identical to workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, executable mode included; `python3 scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py sync` performs the copy)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The live copy is absent from PR CHANGED FILES, and no hunk in the PR diff or the last run diff touches it. scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh (implement_prepush_test_gate_run_once) now passes `--tests-file "${gate_acceptance_tests}"` and `--expect-baseline-fail-file "${gate_acceptance_baseline}"`, which the live hook does not support. The live copy is 1425 lines with no flag mention in its doc block (lines 12-16), while the template is 1625 lines and documents both flags (lines 16-20). `.github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json` does not exist, and mismatched() (lines 117-134) compares bytes and mode. tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:49 fails in CI (run 41432976281, push event, CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA unset per ci.yml lines 616/626). The previous editors' "sandbox-excluded path" deferral does not hold because the file is readable in the checkout. Severity: sonnet MAJOR; gemini, luna and glm BLOCKER. Dissent: minimax_minimax-m3 reported no task gap, citing docs/plans/prepush-affected-test-gate-plan.md:169-170 (G6), under which the drift is expected and is repaired by the post-merge sync PR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (live copy of workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py; check fails at tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:49, test_live_copies_match_their_templates) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The template's run_gate/main hunks add --tests-file and --expect-baseline-fail-file, but the live copy is not in PR CHANGED FILES. scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py mismatched() (line 117) requires a byte-and-mode match. The last two autofix runs deferred the fix as a "sandbox-excluded path".

The run is push-triggered, so CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA is empty and the check is strict, and main goes red after merge. Fix: copy the template over the live file (mode 0755) or run scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py sync, done by a trusted non-sandbox writer. The divergence allowlist is not a valid fix.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:577-586 (_candidates) with cmd_check line 806 (`sort=updated&direction=asc&page={page}`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: First-occurrence de-duplication keeps the older snapshot when an issue moves to a later page between reads.
  WHY: cleanup_disabled (lines 597-600) can remove ai:verify-pending before the window has passed, and check_one (lines 645-648) can bypass the marker_settling guard. This only happens with more than 100 labelled issues. About 4-line fix: `by_number[number] = item`, then sort by _updated_key.

The parity test fails in CI on the PR head.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING (2 related items):
  - scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py _candidates lines 576-588: overwrite by number so the newest occurrence wins, then sort by _updated_key (4 lines).
  - agents.d/8427-p5-persist-postmerge-verify.md "API budget" bullet: change "1 +" to "up to 5 +"; the docstring (lines 53-55) already counts up to 5 list reads (1 line).
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
